title: City College: audit findings that came back
question: Which findings did City College's outside auditors make in the 2015-2025 audits on disk, and which came back year after year?
finding: 36 findings in 7 audits. 12 findings were made in two or more of the years read: Financial Condition of the District (2018, 2019, 2020, 2021); Load Banking (2018, 2019, 2020, 2021); Student Success and Support Program (2016, 2017, 2018); Year End Closing (2014, 2015); Capital Assets (2014, 2015); Preparation of Schedule of Federal Awards (2014, 2015). Load banking lets faculty teach extra now for paid time off later; the auditors found faculty who had been paid full salary while teaching less than a full load, without the banked hours to cover it, and the deficit owed back by faculty stood at $707,924 at June 2021. Questioned costs named in these years total $501,648.
how: Each audit's schedule of findings read from its text layer; a finding is counted in the year of its number (prior-year findings repeated in later reports are not double-counted). Titles are matched across years.
limits: Findings of 2014, 2017 and 2020, whose own reports are not in this folder, are taken from the next year's schedule of prior findings. Years 2023 and 2024 are read on the schools page from other copies. Several years' posted reports are drafts. A repeat finding can be partly corrected. Questioned costs are not losses until a grantor disallows them.
